paper.title_en: Perturbations of a Schwarzschild black hole and Newman-Unti gauge
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we derive the complete transformations of a generic first order perturbative metric in Schwarzschild spacetime to the Newman-Unti (NU) gauge in series expansion near null infinity. This allows us to determine the asymptotic shear, the mass aspect and the angular momentum aspect of the perturbative fields. As a direct application, we derive the corresponding asymptotic NU data for quasinormal modes (QNMs) of a Schwarzschild black hole. The total energy and angular momentum of QNMs obtained from the asymptotic NU data vanish but classical supertranslation charges are non-trivial, which can be applied to fix the BMS frame at first perturbative order.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文完整推导了史瓦西时空中一阶微扰度规到Newman-Unti规范在零无穷附近级数展开的变换，并得到准正规模的渐近NU数据，涉及BMS框架固定的经典超平移荷非平凡性，属于广义相对论基础与渐近结构方向，理论深度与方法细节较充实，可供相关研究者进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 史瓦西黑洞的微扰与Newman-Unti规范
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们推导了史瓦西时空中一个一般一阶微扰度规到Newman-Unti（NU）规范在零无穷附近级数展开的完整变换。这使我们能够确定微扰场的渐近剪切、质量面和角动量面。作为一个直接应用，我们推导了史瓦西黑洞准正规模（QNMs）相应的渐近NU数据。从渐近NU数据获得的QNMs的总能量和角动量消失，但经典超平移荷是非平凡的，这可用于在一阶微扰阶固定BMS框架。
